Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and no worries, travel always throws a wrench in plans. A few paths that usually work for customers in this exact situation: 

1) Record-first, short live Q&A: we run a 30–40 minute targeted demo for the immediate audience, capture a polished recording (we’ll include a short index of timestamps), then schedule a 20–30 min exec Q&A at their availability later in the week. We can include redlined MAP items after the session.

2) Staff rotation / on-site coverage: Ben or Marcus can hop on-site to run a condensed 45-min walkthrough if you’ll have projection and a stable connection. Ben is local to the Bay Area; Marcus can travel but needs a heads-up (he’s out Thurs morning).

3) Move the full 90 minute session to Fri 6/25 11:00am PT or Mon 6/28 2:00pm PT — please let me know which is feasible.

I attached a slimmed-down mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_v3.xlsx) showing what we’d cover in each format and the proposed owners for next steps. Also attaching a short recording-consent.pdf template in case you want us to ship the recording to execs.

If it helps, here’s a 30-min slot link for me: https://calendly.com/redwood/tessa-30m?month=2027-06. I can also coordinate Ben/Marcus availability once you pick a direction.

Quick preference from our side: record-first + short live Q&A is lowest friction and preserves exec context. But we’re happy to send someone on-site if you’d prefer in-person.
